g.text: A relay is a switch operated by an electromagnet.
One input powers the magnet, the other carries the signal.
open when the magnet is off;
power the magnet and it closes.
closed when the magnet is off;
power the magnet and it opens.
Shannon studied relays; today it is semiconductors. The algebra is the same.
Modelling assumption — ideal circuits: no delay, no resistance, no contact bounce.
